historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL exposes only bare 0x24 and unsafe SSH; it lacks mandatory Set Watchdog request fields, readback, safe timeout/action and stop/restore.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED correctly refuses an unspecified timer/action payload that can arm an automatic host reset.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 1000/2291 kept PARTIAL and displayed high-level `mc watchdog set` without arguments, preserving the same undefined configuration.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Reset Watchdog 0x22 refreshes an existing timer and Get Watchdog 0x25 is read-only; neither defines payload for this Set operation.

original_test_intent: Configure the BMC watchdog timer in-band with an intended use, action, pre-timeout and countdown policy, then prove the exact configuration and safe behavior.
original_method: Do not execute the bare raw command. Obtain the vendor-defined full payload, units, reserved-bit rules, firmware scope, readback and supported stop/restore sequence before a separately approved isolated run.
manual_activity: Vendor/engineer must define every Set Watchdog field and safe final state; operator later confirms an isolated target, workload and recovery immediately before any approved one-shot configuration.
safety_requirements: Do not guess action or timeout fields.
Do not arm a production watchdog.
Do not clear logs or use host reset as recovery.
Require readback and supported stop/restore proof.
agent_execution_scope: Static vendor-contract review only while blocked.
No Set command until a new review validates complete bytes and reversible runbook.
After approval, at most one isolated set/readback/observe/stop sequence.
Return evidence without autonomous recovery or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve exact payload, timer behavior and firmware scope.
Approve isolated action, final state and recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unusable: Set Watchdog Timer requires data fields after netfn/command. The bare command and argument-less high-level label cannot express a safe policy and may only fail or behave unpredictably.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No executable command until vendor supplies exact bytes and an independently verified Get/Stop/restore workflow.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Bare 0x06 0x24, Script and 10/5-minute metadata remain preserved as evidence of the missing payload.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define a complete reversible watchdog configuration, validate offline, then re-review an isolated set/readback/observe/restore state machine.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Unknown until firmware and watchdog implementation are confirmed.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor/IPMI watchdog field specification and Project availability plan.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds all missing request semantics and rollback without reducing Set coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Get-only evidence cannot satisfy the Set function; a high-level tool requires documented field equivalence.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Full payload and reversible recovery contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong values can automatically reset/reboot the host and disrupt workloads.

project_override_considerations: A Project-approved high-level or Redfish/vendor watchdog API is acceptable only if every intended raw field and resulting action is mapped, read back and restored; otherwise the original raw method remains unverified.
expected_evidence: Vendor payload/firmware specification and engineer decision
Isolated target plus complete watchdog/host baseline
Exact approved request/response and decoded configured fields
Countdown/action observation with independent host monitor
Supported stop/restore, post-state comparison and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Set Watchdog command is listed without required configuration payload, and Criteria require only command success rather than proof of which timer/action/countdown was set. The intended state is therefore undefined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core command bytes and expected state are missing; supplying routine Project credentials or a package cannot safely determine the watchdog action.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Raises partial gating to formal BLOCKED and rejects unsafe bare execution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Overrides PARTIAL because an argument-less high-level label does not define a configuration.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Does not borrow Reset or Get semantics for the distinct Set operation.

review_improvement: Prevents an unspecified watchdog from being armed and makes readback plus reversal mandatory before execution can be considered.
independent_technical_reasoning: Unlike Reset and Get, Set requires a structured request containing behavior-changing fields. The Master supplies none and has no post-state criterion. Because a guessed action can reboot the SUT, the defect is a core semantic/safety conflict and warrants BLOCKED with engineer/vendor ownership.
